title: Uninfluenced
summary: UNIN'FLUENCED, adjective 1. Not influenced; not persuaded or moved by others, or by foreign considerations; not biased; acting freely. 2. Not proceeding from influence, bias or prejudice; as uninfluen

inlines.v: UNIN'FLUENCED, adjective 1. Not influenced; not persuaded or moved by others, or by foreign considerations; not biased; acting freely. 2. Not proceeding from influence, bias or prejudice; as uninfluenced conduct or actions.
